verdict.rationale: YYLO is a self-hosted, open-source CLI orchestrator with no evidence of a hosted plan/pricing model or subscription tiers; concepts like 'plan-based daily task and concurrency limits' apply to SaaS pricing tiers, not to a locally-run open-source tool where users control their own concurrency via config (e.g., parallel-runner). This story's axis (plan/subscription-based usage limits) does not fit this product's category.
